title: Regional Support Manager
description:
**We're Hiring: Regional Sales Manager | West Region**

ONYX Components and Systems is one of India's leading value-added distributors of advanced electronic components. We are expanding into exciting new technology lines and are looking for a sales leader to grow them across West region.

* Wireless & Connectivity
* Edge AI
* Energy Harvesting
* Power Discretes & Modules

**What you'll do:**

Own the region's sales and marketing, business growth, and targets

Build new customer accounts with OEMs, design houses, EMS companies, and start-ups

Drive design-ins and design-wins from first enquiry to production

Lead, coach, and grow the regional sales team

Work closely with global semiconductor principals on demos, workshops, and campaigns

**Who we're looking for:**

6+ years in technical / B2B sales of electronic components, semiconductors, or embedded products

B.E./B.Tech in ECE / EEE or a related field

Exposure to wireless, edge AI, energy harvesting, or power electronics, and a strong interest in learning the rest

Curious, adaptable, and open to new ways of working; we value the right mindset as much as experience

Comfortable with extensive field travel across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Indore, Daman & Diu

**Why ONYX?**

Ownership of a high-growth region

Hands-on training in emerging technologies with global principals

Visibility to leadership and a chance to build something new

Pay: ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
